title: Comparative Study of Large Language Models on Chinese Film Script Continuation: An Empirical Analysis Based on GPT-5.2 and Qwen-Max
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It focused on the performance of large language models in continuing Chinese film scripts, evaluating aspects like narrative coherence, character consistency, structural preservation, and tone matching.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as this was not a focus of the study. The key findings relate to the comparative performance of GPT-5.2 and Qwen-Max on creative writing tasks, with GPT-5.2 showing superior performance in preserving structure and narrative quality, despite Qwen-Max having slightly higher lexical overlap (ROUGE-L) with the source material.
